tools.name: list_assets
tools.description: List or search assets by name/make/model/location text and/or type.

tools.name: log_maintenance
tools.description: Record completed maintenance on an asset (by id or name, e.g. 'RAM'). Advances the matching schedule; pass an interval to create a schedule if none exists. Updates the asset's odometer/hours if meter_value is higher.

tools.name: whats_due
tools.description: Overdue and upcoming maintenance and pet care (whichever comes first: days, miles or hours), sorted by urgency. Each item has kind (maintenance | pet_care) and task_id for mark_done/snooze_task.

tools.name: add_pantry_item
tools.description: Add a food item. Expiry is estimated from shelf-life rules (category + storage) unless a printed expiry_date is given.

tools.name: list_pantry
tools.description: Pantry items sorted by (estimated) expiry, with days_left.

tools.name: whats_expiring
tools.description: Food expiring within N days (default 3), with a suggested action (cook / freeze / toss).

tools.name: mark_done
tools.description: Tick off a due item from whats_due by task_id: logs it (date defaults to today) and advances the next due date. Returns an undo handle (log_id) for undo_done.

tools.name: list_pets
tools.description: Pets with profile, age, vet, care schedules with due status, recent care log and linked documents.

tools.name: log_pet_care
tools.description: Record pet care done (e.g. 'Rabies vaccine' for Hazel). Completes the matching schedule; pass interval_days to create one if none exists.

tools.name: add_note
tools.description: Save a free-text household note, optionally linked to a pet, asset or document (by id, or pet/asset by name).

tools.name: list_notes
tools.description: Notes (pinned first, newest first). Filter by text or by linked pet/asset/document id.

tools.name: add_to_list
tools.description: Add an item to the shopping list (duplicates of open items are not added twice). Pass pantry_item_id to link it to a pantry item (from list_shopping suggestions), or add_suggestions=true to add every suggestion.

tools.name: list_shopping
tools.description: The shopping list (open items, plus items checked off in the last 3 days) and suggestions: pantry items that are low/out of stock or were used up recently.

tools.name: check_off
tools.description: Tick a shopping list item as bought (by id or name). restock=true also puts the linked pantry item back in stock. checked=false unticks.

tools.name: add_chore
tools.description: Recurring household chore (trash day, water plants, gutters) with an assignee and an optional rotation of people (comma-separated names) that advances each time it is done.

tools.name: get_notifications
tools.description: What's new for this user since this connection last checked: household and neighborhood announcements, chores and to-dos…

tools.name: list_chores
tools.description: Chores with next due date, status, assignee and rotation. Optional filters: assignee, within_days.

tools.name: complete_chore
tools.description: Mark a chore done (advances next due and rotates to the next person) or action=skip (advances the date, same person). Returns log_id for undo=true.

tools.name: get_calendar
tools.description: Dated events between from and to (default today + 30 days): family events (every day they span), maintenance and pet care due dates, chores (recurrences expanded, with whose turn), document expiries and food expiries.

tools.name: get_digest
tools.description: Weekly brief (e.g. Monday): overdue/due tasks and chores, food to use up, low pantry stock, upcoming family events, open…

tools.name: submit_ticket
tools.description: Send a ticket to the app's team: bug, question, feature (request) or support. Optional screenshot as base64 (PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF, under 1 MB).

tools.name: add_event
tools.description: Create a family event on the household calendar (trip, party, appointment, birthday...). Multi-day events show on every day they span. A party gets a shareable RSVP link (rsvp_url) to paste into any messenger.

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: Family events, optionally between from and to (YYYY-MM-DD; recurring events included when an occurrence falls in range), filtered by q (title/location/notes/attendees) or category. Parties include RSVP totals.

tools.name: update_event
tools.description: Change any field of a family event (only the fields you pass change).

tools.name: list_people
tools.description: People on the People page (household members for records, chores and rotations) with their Staying with us note, stay date ranges, and whether they are here today (away=true when outside every range).

tools.name: list_todos
tools.description: One-off household to-dos (not recurring chores): open ones with due date, assignee and status (overdue, due_today, upcoming, no_date), plus done ones from the last 30 days.

tools.name: add_todo
tools.description: Add a one-off to-do (call the plumber, return library books, sign the permission slip) with optional notes, due date and assignee. Use this for anything done once; use add_chore only for repeating jobs.

tools.name: complete_todo
tools.description: Check off a to-do (undo: true reopens it). Kids can only check off their own.

tools.name: get_started
tools.description: Setup checklist for this household: account and email confirmation, household name, people, members and invites, chores; with the next tool to call for each step. Call this first after a new sign-up.

tools.name: get_custody_calendar
tools.description: Shared custody calendar: which parent has the kids each day (template, holidays and approved changes) plus handoffs, between from and to (max 120 days, default next 28).

tools.name: find_tools
tools.description: Search the 203 household tools beyond the core list (events, RSVPs, meals, recipes, bills, renewals, medical, inventory, providers, guest passes, house info, wall display, rides, rewards, checklists, members...).

tools.name: call_tool
tools.description: Run any household tool by name (see find_tools) with its arguments. Same permissions and confirm steps as calling it directly.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_notifications, get_started · Private data: log_maintenance, list_pets, log_pet_care, add_note, list_notes, get_calendar, list_people · Public sink: submit_ticket, get_started · Destructive: call_tool.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_notifications, get_started · Private data: log_maintenance, list_pets, log_pet_care, add_note, list_notes, get_calendar, list_people · Public sink: submit_ticket, get_started · Destructive: call_tool

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
